The name of this class of medications comes from the Hantzsch–Widman chemical naming system. The prefix is derived from the French word denoting nitrogen and the suffix indicates a five-membered aromatic ring. They are grouped by how many nitrogen atoms are packed into their 5-membered rings

What causes wood-destroying rot? Specialized drugs in this class were developed to serve as the primary chemical shields in wood preservation. They are deeply infused into industrial timber and outdoor structures worldwide to prevent rot and structural failure

This class of medications work by blocking lanosterol 14-alpha demethylase, a fungal cytochrome P450 enzyme needed to create ergosterol. They can cross react with human P450 enzymes leading to major drug-drug interactions but have a wide range of uses such as athlete's foot, oral thrush, candidiasis, cryptococcosis, and histoplasmosis.
